title: Among all female superheroes with intelligence as one of their attributes (
question: Among all female superheroes with intelligence as one of their attributes (not powers), find those whose height exceeds 80% of the average height of all superheroes. For these heroes, return their names, intelligence attribute values, and the count of distinct superpowers they possess.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    s.XCL_019 AS name,
    ha.XCL_011 AS intelligence_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT hp.XCL_013) AS superpower_count
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
  AND s.XCL_028 > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG(XCL_028) FROM superhero)
GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_019, ha.XCL_011

SELECT 
    s.XCL_019 AS name,
    ha.XCL_011 AS intelligence_value,
    COUNT(DISTINCT sp.XCL_030) AS superpower_count
FROM superhero s
INNER JOIN gender g ON s.XCL_021 = g.XCL_007
INNER JOIN hero_attribute ha ON s.XCL_018 = ha.XCL_009
INNER JOIN attribute a ON ha.XCL_010 = a.XCL_003
LEFT JOIN hero_power hp ON s.XCL_018 = hp.XCL_012
LEFT JOIN superpower sp ON hp.XCL_013 = sp.XCL_030
WHERE g.XCL_008 = 'Female'
  AND a.XCL_004 = 'Intelligence'
  AND s.XCL_028 > 0.8 * (SELECT AVG(XCL_028) FROM superhero)
GROUP BY s.XCL_018, s.XCL_019, ha.XCL_011
